lead.en: XR here means extended reality: a field, a class of systems, and a kind of experience. In the OpenXR specification that one name covers virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality. AI glasses are not a third sibling beside VR and AR. They are a product category — glasses plus an assistant that can hear, see, or translate — and a pair is also an XR device only when it actually does VR, AR, or MR. This log records what was shipped or published, newest first, and is meant to be refreshed about every 10 days. Implants, and the Phase Lock chapter, stay on the BCI page.
lead.zh: 本页的 XR 指扩展现实：它是一个领域，一类系统，也是一种体验。OpenXR 规范用这一个名字罩住虚拟现实、增强现实和混合现实。AI 眼镜不是排在 VR 和 AR 旁边的第三种同类。它是产品类别——一副眼镜，加上能听、能看或能翻译的助手——只有这副眼镜真的在做 VR、AR 或 MR 时，它才同时算 XR 设备。本页记录已经发售或发表的进展，新的在前，大约每 10 天补一次。植入式设备和《Phase Lock》专题仍在脑机接口页。

note.en: Tags name a device class or a capability (camera glasses, display glasses, AR, VR, MR, a platform, a paper). They are not three equal kinds of media. Read the taxonomy under the latest list before treating two tags as siblings. Dates are China time (UTC+8). Only facts with a working source are included.
note.zh: 标签标的是设备类型或能力（无显示的相机眼镜、带显示的眼镜、AR、VR、MR、平台、论文），不是三种并列的媒介。先看最新动态下面的概念说明，再决定两个标签算不算同一层。日期为北京时间（UTC+8）。只收录能打开来源的事实。

lead.en: The row under XR is VR, AR, and MR. AI glasses sit beside that row, not in it. A camera is not a display, and a display is not AR.
lead.zh: XR 下面那一排是 VR、AR、MR。AI 眼镜站在这排旁边，不站在里面。有相机不等于有显示，有显示也不等于 AR。

aside.en: AI glasses are a product class: a glasses form factor plus an AI capability. They overlap the row above only when that pair also does VR, AR, or MR. Camera glasses with no display need not be XR at all, unless a platform’s own device list puts them there.
aside.zh: AI 眼镜是产品类别：眼镜这种外形，加上 AI 能力。只有这副眼镜同时在做 VR、AR 或 MR 时，它才和上面那一排重叠。没有显示的相机眼镜可以完全不算 XR，除非某个平台自己的设备表把它算进去。

products_label.en: AI glasses, by what they can do
products_label.zh: AI 眼镜，按它实际能做什么

means.en: Extended reality. OpenXR’s introduction uses XR for a continuum of real-and-virtual environments made by computers in interaction with a person, and says that continuum includes the technologies of VR, AR, and MR. The same word can name the field, a system, or an experience.
means.zh: 扩展现实。OpenXR 导言用 XR 指计算机通过人机交互生成的、从真实到虚拟的一串环境，并写明其中包含 VR、AR、MR 的技术。同一个词可以指这个领域、一套系统，或一次体验。

not.en: Not a fourth product next to “AI glasses,” and not a synonym for any one headset.
not.zh: 不是排在「AI 眼镜」旁边的第四种产品，也不是某一款头显的别名。

means.en: The virtual environment is the primary space. Tracking is often described as 3DoF (rotation only: look around) or 6DoF (rotation and translation: move through the space). Microsoft’s mixed-reality primer uses 6DoF for both rotation and translation.
means.zh: 虚拟环境是主要空间。追踪常分成三自由度（只能转头、环顾）和六自由度（转头，并在空间里移动）。微软的混合现实导读把六自由度写成既有旋转也有平移。

not.en: Not “only 3D graphics.” A 360 photo or video is a format. It can be played in a VR headset or on a flat screen. Glasses-shaped hardware can still be VR: Meta VR Glasses are that case, a virtual display in a glasses form with the computer in a puck.
not.zh: 不是「只有三维动画才算」。360 照片或视频是一种格式，可以在 VR 头显里放，也可以在平面屏幕上放。眼镜外形的硬件仍然可以是 VR：Meta VR Glasses 就是这样，虚拟画面装在眼镜形态里，计算放在计算盒中。

means.en: Digital content in the reality you perceive. Ronald Azuma’s 1997 survey describes AR as 3D virtual objects integrated into a 3D real environment in real time. This page uses the three requirements that follow: real and virtual are combined, the combination is interactive in real time, and the virtual is registered in three dimensions to the real scene. People have built that with a phone or tablet, optical see-through glasses, a video see-through headset, or a projector.
means.zh: 数字内容出现在你所感知的现实里。Ronald Azuma 1997 年的综述把 AR 写成：三维虚拟物体被实时整合进三维的真实环境。本页采用由此而来的三条：真实与虚拟被结合在一起，结合是实时可交互的，虚拟内容在三维上配准到真实场景。手机或平板、光学透视眼镜、视频透视头显、投影，都有人用来做这件事。

not.en: A screen is not AR. A notification fixed in a glasses HUD is not AR, unless it is registered to the place in the world it refers to.
not.zh: 有一块屏幕不等于 AR。固定在眼镜 HUD 里的一条通知也不等于 AR，除非它配准到它所谈论的那个真实位置上。

means.en: The name moves. Microsoft’s discover page traces “mixed reality” to Paul Milgram and Fumio Kishino’s 1994 taxonomy and their virtuality continuum, from a fully physical environment to a fully digital one, and also uses MR for experiences that can sit a hologram in the room or move between an augmented view and a virtual one. Product copy often stresses digital objects that share the real space.
means.zh: 这个名字并不固定。微软的导读页把 “mixed reality” 追溯到 Paul Milgram 与 Fumio Kishino 1994 年的分类和他们的虚拟连续统：从完全的物理环境到完全的数字环境。同一页也用 MR 指可以把全息物体放进房间、或在增强视图和虚拟视图之间切换的体验。产品文案则常常强调数字物体与真实空间待在一起。

not.en: Not “AR only overlays, and only MR can interact.” Interaction is not the property that separates the two words. When a source says MR, this page says which sense it is using.
not.zh: 不是「AR 只会叠加，只有 MR 才能交互」。交互并不是把这两个词分开的那条性质。来源说 MR 时，本页会注明它用的是哪一种意思。

means.en: A product category: glasses you can wear, plus an AI capability such as voice, camera understanding, or translation. Meta’s own 2025 split, on the about.fb.com note for Ray-Ban Display, is three product lines: Camera AI glasses (Ray-Ban and Oakley, no claim there of a display), Display AI glasses (a contextual in-lens display; Ray-Ban Display), and augmented-reality glasses (a large holographic display; the Orion prototype). Google’s Android XR glasses note lists a camera, microphones, and speakers, and an in-lens display as optional. Android’s device page, updated 19 May 2026, lists audio glasses and display glasses as device classes on the XR platform, next to headsets and wired see-through glasses.
means.zh: 产品类别：能戴的眼镜，加上语音、看懂相机画面或翻译这类 AI 能力。Meta 在 2025 年 about.fb.com 介绍 Ray-Ban Display 的文章里，把自己的 AI 眼镜分成三档：相机 AI 眼镜（Ray-Ban 与 Oakley，那里并没有说有显示）、显示 AI 眼镜（镜片里一块随情境出现的显示；即 Ray-Ban Display）、增强现实眼镜（大面积全息显示；Orion 原型）。Google 写 Android XR 眼镜时列出相机、麦克风和扬声器，并把镜片显示写成可有可无。Android 设备页（2026 年 5 月 19 日更新）把音频眼镜和显示眼镜列为 XR 平台上的设备档，和头显、有线透视眼镜并列。

not.en: Not automatically a member of XR. Whether “AI glasses are a kind of XR” depends on the cut. By capability, a camera-only pair that never registers graphics to the room is not AR, VR, or MR. By platform, Android XR’s list includes those audio glasses anyway. A display HUD can be AI glasses and still fail Azuma’s registration test. A spatial-AR pair can be both AI glasses and AR or MR. Meta VR Glasses are glasses-shaped VR with a compute puck, not the “AI glasses versus VR” choice.
not.zh: 不会自动变成 XR 的一种。『AI 眼镜算不算 XR』取决于你按能力分还是按平台分。按能力，一副只有相机、从不把图形配准到房间里的眼镜，不是 AR、VR 或 MR。按平台，Android XR 的设备表照样收了这种音频眼镜。一块 HUD 可以是 AI 眼镜，同时过不了 Azuma 的配准要求。一副做了空间配准的眼镜，可以既是 AI 眼镜，又是 AR 或 MR。Meta VR Glasses 是眼镜形态的 VR 加计算盒，不是「AI 眼镜还是 VR」这种二选一。

label.en: Azuma, A Survey of Augmented Reality (1997)
Meta, three types of AI glasses
Google, Android XR glasses, display optional
label.zh: Google：Android XR 眼镜，显示可选

text.en: K’s neural media are media built on neural networks: they sense, model, and generate. A caption on the world, an answer about the object you are looking at, or a generated face sent back on a call is that kind of media when it lives in glasses or a headset. This page marks that angle on an entry when the source supports it. It does not retell the BCI page. Phase Lock stays there. Meta’s Neural Band, in the company’s 2025 announcement, is an EMG wristband that reads muscle activity. That is not an implant.
text.zh: K 的神经媒体是建立在神经网络上的媒介：它感知、建模，再生成内容。给眼前的世界加字幕、回答你正在看的物体、或在通话里送回一张生成的脸，当这些发生在眼镜或头显里时，就是这种媒介。来源撑得住时，条目下会标出这一面。本页不重写脑机接口页。《Phase Lock》仍在那边。Meta 在 2025 年的发布里把 Neural Band 写成读取肌肉活动的 EMG 腕带。那不是植入体。

label.en: Phase Lock, on the BCI page
Meta on the Neural Band (muscle activity)
label.zh: Meta 谈 Neural Band（肌肉活动）

title.en: Gentle Monster’s Intelligent Eyewear: camera-and-audio Gemini glasses, US pre-orders reported for 12 November
title.zh: Gentle Monster 的 Intelligent Eyewear：相机加音频的 Gemini 眼镜，报道称美国 11 月 12 日预售

summary.en: Gentle Monster’s own page describes Intelligent Eyewear made with Google and Samsung: a second, rectangular frame beside the one shown at Google I/O, with the debut collection still called “this fall.” With Gemini it lists real-time translation, navigation, contextual help, and visual understanding, on Android or iOS, through an app and by voice. Battery is up to nine hours, and the case adds seven or more charges. The page does not describe an in-lens display. The Korea Herald, published 8 November 2026, reports that US pre-orders open on Thursday — 12 November, the same day Warby Parker already named — ahead of a December release, that a public preview runs in New York from 13 to 23 November, and that a Korea date and a price are not set. It also says Qualcomm took part. Samsung’s 20 May newsroom, the first official look, calls the glasses a companion to the phone: voice, photos, spoken translation, and text on a menu or a sign read in the line of sight. Google’s Android XR lead is quoted there. TechCrunch’s report from I/O on 19 May says Google called the devices audio glasses. This entry is tagged camera AI glasses and platform. It is not tagged as a display HUD, and not as AR: hearing a translation of a sign is not the same as graphics registered in the room.
summary.zh: Gentle Monster 自己的页面把 Intelligent Eyewear 写成与 Google、三星合作的眼镜：除了 Google I/O 上的第一款，又公开了第二款方框，首发系列仍写着「今年秋天」。有了 Gemini，页面列出实时翻译、导航、情境帮助和视觉理解，通过应用和语音，兼容 Android 与 iOS。续航最多九小时，充电盒再提供七次或更多充电。页面没有写镜片里的显示。韩国先驱报 2026 年 11 月 8 日报道：美国预售在周四开放，也就是 11 月 12 日，与 Warby Parker 已经说定的是同一天；12 月发货；11 月 13 日至 23 日在纽约公开展示；韩国上市日和价格都还没有。报道还说高通参与了项目。三星 5 月 20 日的新闻室稿是官方第一次亮相，把这副眼镜写成手机的伴侣：语音、拍照、口语翻译，以及视线里菜单或招牌上的文字。稿中引用了 Google Android XR 负责人的话。TechCrunch 对 5 月 19 日 I/O 的报道说，Google 称这些设备为音频眼镜。这条标为相机 AI 眼镜和平台。不标显示 HUD，也不标 AR：把招牌上的字听成翻译，并不等于图形配准在房间里。

cover_alt.en: Portrait of a person in a burgundy jacket wearing thick black rectangular glasses with a small module on the temple.
cover_alt.zh: 人像：一人穿酒红夹克，戴着粗黑方框眼镜，镜腿上有一小块模块。

cover_credit.en: Image: Gentle Monster, Intelligent Eyewear page.
cover_credit.zh: 图片：Gentle Monster，Intelligent Eyewear 页面。

nm.en: The neural-media angle is a model that hears the room and answers about what the camera is pointed at, spoken back through the frame. The phone still holds the apps. Nothing on these pages puts a registered graphic into the street.
nm.zh: 和神经媒体相关的一面，是一个模型听着房间、回答相机正对着的东西，再从镜框里说出来。应用仍在手机上。这些页面都没有把配准过的图形放进街道。

label.zh: 韩国先驱报，2026 年 11 月 8 日
三星新闻室，首次亮相（2026 年 5 月 20 日）
TechCrunch 写 I/O：Google 称之为音频眼镜
同一合作里的 Warby Parker 镜框

title.en: Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear: Samsung hardware, Gemini in the ear, pre-orders 12 November
title.zh: Warby Parker Intelligent Eyewear：三星硬件，Gemini 在耳朵里，11 月 12 日预售

summary.en: Warby Parker’s product page says the frames are made with Google and Samsung, for all-day wear, and lists what they do: in-ear live translation, or look at text and ask to hear it translated; turn-by-turn directions; photos and video; open-ear music and podcasts; questions about the surroundings answered by Gemini; calls, texts, and appointments by voice. It does not describe an in-lens display. The design line on the page is Warby’s own: prescription know-how plus Google’s AI plus Samsung’s hardware. Samsung’s 20 May 2026 newsroom is the first official look, and it quotes Shahram Izadi, who leads Android XR at Google, on the same partnership with Gentle Monster. TechCrunch, reporting I/O that week, says Google presented the devices as audio glasses. The dated commercial fact is still the 5 November earnings release: co-CEO Dave Gilboa says US pre-orders open on 12 November, with holiday-season delivery. On the call the same day he added that the full collection and the price appear on 12 November, that first deliveries begin in mid-December, and that demos start the week of 9 November in 65 stores. Tagged camera AI glasses and platform. Not a display HUD, and not AR.
summary.zh: Warby Parker 的产品页写明，镜框与 Google、三星一起做，为全天佩戴，并列出它能做的事：耳朵里的实时翻译，或者看着文字请它读出译文；逐步导航；拍照和录像；开放式耳机听歌和播客；用 Gemini 询问周围的事物；用语音打电话、发短信、订日程。页面没有写镜片里的显示。设计上的说法是 Warby 自己的：验光和镜框，加上 Google 的 AI，加上三星的硬件。三星 2026 年 5 月 20 日的新闻室稿是官方第一次亮相，其中引用了 Google Android XR 负责人 Shahram Izadi，谈的是与 Gentle Monster 的同一项合作。当周 TechCrunch 写 I/O 时说，Google 把这些设备呈现为音频眼镜。有日期的商业事实仍是 11 月 5 日的业绩稿：联席首席执行官 Dave Gilboa 说美国预售 11 月 12 日开始，假期档交付。同一天的电话上他又说，完整系列和价格在 12 日公布，首批交付从 12 月中旬开始，店内试戴从 11 月 9 日那一周的 65 家店开始。标为相机 AI 眼镜和平台。不是显示 HUD，也不是 AR。

cover_alt.en: Close portrait of a person wearing brown cat-eye glasses with small camera modules at the outer corners.
cover_alt.zh: 近景人像：一人戴着棕色猫眼镜框，外眼角处有小的相机模块。

cover_credit.en: Image: Warby Parker, Intelligent Eyewear page.
cover_credit.zh: 图片：Warby Parker，Intelligent Eyewear 页面。

nm.en: Gemini answering about what is around you, through a camera and a speaker in ordinary glasses, is the neural-media angle: a model in the line of sight that still does not draw a registered layer on the world. The phone remains the other half of the device.
nm.zh: Gemini 通过普通眼镜上的相机和扬声器回答你周围的事物，这是和神经媒体相关的一面：模型在视线里，但并没有在世界上画一层配准过的图形。手机仍是这台设备的另一半。

label.zh: 2026 年第三季业绩稿（11 月 12 日预售）
业绩电话：12 月中旬交付，65 家店

title.en: Quest 2 and Quest Pro get a last feature release, then security patches only
title.zh: Quest 2 与 Quest Pro 的功能更新走到最后一版，之后只剩安全补丁

summary.en: Meta told Quest developers that Horizon OS v2.13 is the final feature release for Quest 2 and Quest Pro, and that v213 is the last SDK it will support on those headsets. The help page says the rollout is planned to start in January 2027 and reach every headset in March 2027. After that, security patches and critical bug fixes continue through December 2027. Existing apps keep working, the Store stays open, cross-play with Quest 3 and Quest 3S continues, and developers can keep updating apps they already shipped. New app submissions for these two headsets close in December 2027. The Verge’s clock on the announcement is 2 November 2026, 9:04 pm UTC, which is 3 November in China. The same developer post calls Quest 3 and Quest 3S the baseline and points ahead to Meta VR Glasses. Those glasses are a separate, glasses-shaped VR device with a puck; they are not a replacement label for these headsets.
summary.zh: Meta 告诉 Quest 开发者：Horizon OS v2.13 是 Quest 2 和 Quest Pro 的最后一版功能更新，v213 是这两款头显上最后支持的 SDK。帮助页写明，推送计划于 2027 年 1 月开始，2027 年 3 月覆盖全部设备。之后到 2027 年 12 月仍有安全补丁和关键故障修复。已经买到的应用继续能用，商店继续开着，和 Quest 3、Quest 3S 的联机还在，开发者也可以继续给已经上架的应用发更新。针对这两款头显的新应用提交在 2027 年 12 月截止。The Verge 给这条宣布标的时间是 2026 年 11 月 2 日 21:04 UTC，换算到中国是 11 月 3 日。同一篇开发者文章把 Quest 3 和 Quest 3S 写成今后的基线，并指向 Meta VR Glasses。那是另一款眼镜形态的 VR，计算在盒子里，不是给这两款头显换了个名字。

source.zh: Meta Horizon OS 开发者博客

nm.en: The post’s point for this archive is the platform cut: new OS features stop on the 2020 and 2022 headsets, and Meta says apps built for Quest 3 carry onto the glasses-form VR device because they share an OS. That is a distribution fact, not a claim that the old headsets grew a new sensing layer.
nm.zh: 对这个资料库要紧的是平台分界：2020 和 2022 年的头显不再接收新的系统功能，Meta 说为 Quest 3 做的应用可以跟着到眼镜形态的 VR 上，因为操作系统是同一套。这是分发上的事实，不是说旧头显长出了一层新的感知。

label.en: Quest help: what changes for owners
label.zh: Quest 帮助页：对使用者意味着什么
The Verge，标为 2026 年 11 月 2 日

title.en: visionOS 27.2: Siri can be limited by app, and a call can add an interpreter
title.zh: visionOS 27.2：Siri 可以按应用限制，通话可以加上手语译员

summary.en: Apple’s security note says visionOS 27.2 was released on 26 October 2026. The feature list on Apple’s support page, which also carries that date, adds three things beyond bug fixes. Excluded Apps is one setting for which apps Siri, Search, and suggestions may use. A Siri reply can be selected and copied in part, not only as a whole. Siri AI adds French, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish, and Apple says it is not available in mainland China. Photos and Image Playground can use SynthID watermarks to mark images that generative tools created or changed. FaceTime can add a third-party sign-language interpreter or a live captioner to a call. Vision Pro remains a video-see-through headset: the opaque displays can replace the room (VR) or show it through cameras with spatial windows (the product sense of MR). This update does not, by itself, describe a new registration method.
summary.zh: Apple 的安全说明写明 visionOS 27.2 于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布。同一天更新的支持页在故障修复之外加了三组功能。Excluded Apps 用一个开关决定 Siri、搜索和建议能用哪些应用。Siri 的回复可以只选中、复制其中一段，而不必整段拿走。Siri AI 增加法语、日语、韩语和西班牙语，Apple 写明中国大陆不可用。照片和 Image Playground 可以用 SynthID 水印标出生成工具做过的图像。FaceTime 可以把第三方手语译员或实时字幕员加进一通通话。Vision Pro 仍是视频透视头显：不透明的屏幕可以换成虚拟空间（VR），也可以用相机把房间播回来并摆上空间窗口（产品意义上的 MR）。这次更新本身没有描述一种新的三维配准方法。

source.zh: Apple 支持《关于 visionOS 27 的更新》

date_display.zh: 2026 年 10 月 26 日那一周

title.en: Horizon OS 2.10, on the public test channel: a theater, and avatar video calls
title.zh: Horizon OS 2.10 公开测试通道：剧场模式，以及虚拟形象视频通话

summary.en: Meta’s Quest release notes date Horizon OS 2.10 to the public test channel for the week of 26 October 2026. It is not described there as a finished rollout to every headset. Theater plays video on a cinema-scale screen inside a theater environment and hides your other windows; in a supported media app you turn it on from More options on the control bar. In Chats, a video call can show your avatar instead of only audio. The build also changes how the headset checks that a site is genuine. A theater is a virtual environment used as the primary space, so this entry is tagged VR. The notes do not say the theater is mixed into the physical room.
summary.zh: Meta 的 Quest 发布说明把 Horizon OS 2.10 标成 2026 年 10 月 26 日那一周的公开测试通道版本，并没有写成已经推给每一台头显。剧场模式在一个剧场环境里用影院尺寸的屏幕播放视频，并藏起其他窗口；在支持的媒体应用里，从控制条的更多选项打开。聊天里的视频通话可以显示你的虚拟形象，而不只是语音。这一版也改了头显如何确认网站是真的。剧场把虚拟环境当成主要空间，所以这条标为 VR。发布说明没有说剧场被混进了物理房间。

date_display.zh: 2026 年 10 月 19 日那一周

title.en: Horizon OS 2.9 places windows in the room and extends Meta AI on Quest
title.zh: Horizon OS 2.9 把窗口放进房间，并扩大 Quest 上的 Meta AI

summary.en: Meta’s Quest notes say version 2.9 starts reaching Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest Pro, and Quest 2 in the week of 19 October 2026. Windows now open spatially: a window manager can set three side by side or in a stack, and a window moved near a wall snaps to it. The old standalone anchor control is gone. Surface Keyboard and Touchpad, still marked experimental, now work in fully virtual environments as well as in passthrough, on Quest 3 and Quest 3S. A QR scanner can be opened from quick controls, the camera app, search, or the phrase “Hey Meta, open QR code scanner,” on Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Meta AI adds Australia, Japan, Mexico, the UK, South Korea, and Singapore, and the languages German, French, Korean, Japanese, UK English, Spanish, and Italian. Some older VR Home environments return. If boundary setup is interrupted, the headset falls back to the previous boundary or a stationary one. Snapping a panel to a wall is the product sense of mixed reality: a digital object given a place in the room. It is not a claim that every panel meets Azuma’s registration test, and it is not a separate “MR can interact, AR cannot” distinction.
summary.zh: Meta 的 Quest 说明写：2.9 从 2026 年 10 月 19 日那一周开始推向 Quest 3、Quest 3S、Quest Pro 和 Quest 2。窗口改为在空间里打开：窗口管理器可以把三个窗口并排或叠放，窗口靠近墙时会吸到墙上。原来单独的锚定按钮取消了。仍标为实验功能的表面键盘和触控板，在 Quest 3 和 Quest 3S 上现在既能在透视里用，也能在完全虚拟的环境里用。二维码扫描可以从快捷控制、相机、搜索，或一句 “Hey Meta, open QR code scanner” 打开，限于 Quest 3 和 Quest 3S。Meta AI 新增澳大利亚、日本、墨西哥、英国、韩国和新加坡，语言加上德语、法语、韩语、日语、英式英语、西班牙语和意大利语。一部分旧的 VR 主页环境回来了。边界设置如果被打断，头显退回上一道边界，或改成原地边界。把一块面板吸到墙上，是产品意义上的混合现实：给数字物体一个房间里的位置。这并不是说每一块面板都满足 Azuma 的配准要求，也不是「MR 能交互、AR 不能」那种划分。

nm.en: Meta AI on the headset is a model you talk to inside the same system that is also placing windows on the walls. The neural-media angle is that split attention: a generated answer and a spatial layout in one device. The release notes do not describe what the model sees.
nm.zh: 头显里的 Meta AI 是你在同一套系统里说话的模型，而这套系统同时也把窗口摆到墙上。和神经媒体相关的一面是这种被分开的注意力：生成的回答和空间布局在同一台设备上。发布说明没有写这个模型看见了什么。

title.en: GazeAgent: calibrating gaze on AI glasses from ordinary hand–eye moments
title.zh: GazeAgent：用日常的手眼动作给 AI 眼镜校正视线

summary.en: arXiv:2610.24364, submitted 17 October 2026, describes GazeAgent. The authors’ abstract says AI glasses usually need an explicit, per-person eye-tracker calibration, and that the calibration drifts when the frame shifts. Their system looks for short “precise visual attention” moments in IMU, gaze, and hand signals, checks that the moment belongs to the task, and treats the center of the functional target — a port, a tape edge — as a stand-in calibration point, so the wearer is not stopped for a dot grid. In a scripted study with 10 people it reports detecting all 820 predefined opportunities and, after the device was disturbed, cutting median gaze error by 44.1 percent against explicit calibration. A five-person case study reports the lowest workload and interruption scores for the automatic mode, and that all five preferred it for routine use. The study was approved by the University of California San Diego IRB. The paper is about egocentric AI glasses and AR/XR headsets. It does not assign the hardware to Meta’s camera / display / AR product split, so this entry is tagged research only.
summary.zh: arXiv:2610.24364，2026 年 10 月 17 日提交，写的是 GazeAgent。作者在摘要里说，AI 眼镜通常要做一次因人而异的显式眼动校准，镜框一挪，校准就会漂。他们的系统在惯性传感器、视线和手的信号里找短暂的「精确视觉注意」片段，核对这段动作确实属于当前任务，然后把功能目标的中心——一个插口、一条胶带的边——当作替代校准点，这样佩戴者不用停下来盯点阵。十人脚本实验报告说，820 个预先定义的机会全部被检出；设备被扰动之后，视线误差的中位数比显式校准低了 44.1%。五人的个案报告说，自动模式的负荷和被打断感最低，五人都更愿意在日常里用它。研究经加利福尼亚大学圣迭戈分校伦理委员会批准。论文讨论的是第一人称 AI 眼镜和 AR/XR 头显。它没有把硬件归进 Meta 的相机 / 显示 / AR 产品三分法，所以这条只标研究。

nm.en: The neural-media angle is attention as a signal the device learns from, instead of a menu that stops the person. The glasses treat ordinary looking-and-doing as training data for where the wearer meant to look. That is a model sitting on first-person sensing, which is the part that belongs next to neural media, whether or not the hardware is AR.
nm.zh: 和神经媒体相关的一面是：注意力成了设备拿来学习的信号，而不是叫人停下来的菜单。眼镜把平常的「看一看、做一做」当成训练数据，用来判断佩戴者本来想看哪里。这是一个模型坐在第一人称传感上面。不管这台硬件算不算 AR，这一面都挨着神经媒体。

title.en: ISMAR workshop: an agent, not the user, decides what wearable MR shows
title.zh: ISMAR 工作坊：可穿戴 MR 显示什么，改由代理来决定

summary.en: The workshop site for AHIMR ’26 says it ran as a half-day hybrid session at ISMAR in Bari on 5 October 2026, 09:00–13:00 CEST, which is the same calendar day in China. It says 12 of 16 submissions were accepted and that the papers are in the ISMAR 2026 adjunct proceedings on IEEE Xplore; this page has not opened Xplore to re-check each PDF. The site’s framing is that the hard problem is no longer what a glasses display can show, but how an AI agent should decide what to surface, in what form, and when, while the person’s attention is split between the room and the overlay. Mark Billinghurst’s keynote is listed as “Research Directions in AI-Mediated Heads-Up Interaction.” The tag is MR because that is the workshop’s own name for the wearable systems it discusses, plus research. It is not a product release.
summary.zh: AHIMR ’26 的工作坊网站写：它是 ISMAR 在巴里的半天混合活动，2026 年 10 月 5 日中欧夏令时 9:00 至 13:00，换到中国仍是同一天。网站说 16 篇投稿收了 12 篇，论文收入 ISMAR 2026 附刊并上 IEEE Xplore；本页没有逐篇打开 Xplore 核对 PDF。网站把难题写成：不再是眼镜显示能画出什么，而是 AI 代理该在什么时候、用什么形式、把什么送到人眼前，而这个人的注意力正拆在房间和叠加层之间。Mark Billinghurst 的主题演讲被列为《AI 中介的抬头交互：研究方向》。标签用 MR，是因为工作坊自己用这个词称呼它讨论的可穿戴系统，另外标研究。这不是一次产品发布。

nm.en: The workshop’s question is a neural-media question in wearable form: a model chooses what reaches the eye, and attention is treated as a scarce resource. That is about generation and selection, not about a brain implant.
nm.zh: 工作坊的问题是穿戴形式上的神经媒体问题：一个模型决定什么进入眼睛，注意力被当成稀缺资源。这是关于生成和筛选，不是关于脑部植入。

title.en: Meta’s glasses toolkit hits 1.0, and web apps run on the Ray-Ban Display
title.zh: Meta 的眼镜工具包到 1.0，网页应用跑在 Ray-Ban Display 上

summary.en: Meta’s developer recap of Connect says the glasses updates in that post begin rolling out on 30 September 2026. After a year of preview, Wearables Device Access Toolkit 1.0 is described as a stable release: a phone app keeps its own logic, and the glasses become a hands-free front end, on display glasses and on glasses with no display. People launch apps with “Hey Meta,” speech is turned into commands, and a swipe on the Neural Band can steer. Web apps for Ray-Ban Display are HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with no separate native app. The same post says an app can read device position, location, and wrist motion from the band, and can take text by dictation, handwriting, or an on-screen keyboard. WebMCP, in developer preview, lets the developer declare what Meta AI is allowed to control inside the app. Meta AI connectors expose a service’s API as tools the assistant can call. Discovery in an on-glasses Explore app is described as coming soon, not as already open. Meta’s web-apps guide says the display these apps draw on is a 600×600 additive panel, where a dark background falls away. That is a display HUD. This entry does not call it AR: the guide does not say the pixels are registered to the room.
summary.zh: Meta 回顾 Connect 的开发者文章说，文中的眼镜更新从 2026 年 9 月 30 日开始推送。预览一年之后，可穿戴设备访问工具包 1.0 被写成稳定版：手机应用保留自己的逻辑，眼镜变成免提的前端，有显示和没显示的眼镜都算。用户用 “Hey Meta” 打开应用，语音被转成指令，Neural Band 上滑一下可以操控。给 Ray-Ban Display 写的网页应用就是 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript，不需要另外的原生应用。同一篇文章说，应用可以读取设备姿态、位置，以及腕带上的手腕动作，文字可以用听写、手写或屏幕键盘输入。仍在开发者预览中的 WebMCP 让开发者声明 Meta AI 在应用里可以动哪些东西。Meta AI connectors 把一项服务的 API 变成助手可以调用的工具。眼镜上的 Explore 发现入口被写成即将到来，不是已经开放。Meta 的网页应用文档说，这些应用画上去的是一块 600×600 的加法显示，深色背景会隐去。这是一块 HUD。这条不把它叫做 AR：文档没有说这些像素配准到了房间里。

source.en: Meta, Connect recap for AI glasses developers
source.zh: Meta：面向 AI 眼镜开发者的 Connect 回顾

cover_alt.zh: 棚拍人像：一人戴着厚框黑色 Ray-Ban 眼镜和深色编织腕带，手抬在下巴附近。

cover_credit.zh: 图片：Meta，《让 Meta Ray-Ban Display 对更多人更有用》（2026 年 9 月 23 日）。

nm.en: A page that runs on the glasses and that Meta AI is allowed to operate is a generated layer in the line of sight. The neural-media angle is that handoff: the model can act inside an app the person is wearing. The band’s swipe is muscle sensing at the wrist, which the 2025 announcement describes as EMG, not a brain implant.
nm.zh: 跑在眼镜上、并允许 Meta AI 去操作的页面，是视线里的一层生成内容。和神经媒体相关的一面是这个交接：模型可以在人正戴着的应用里行动。腕带上的滑动是手腕处的肌肉传感。2025 年的发布把它写成 EMG，不是脑部植入。

label.zh: 网页应用文档，含 600×600 显示

title.en: Meta VR Glasses: virtual reality in a glasses form, computer in a puck
title.zh: Meta VR Glasses：眼镜形态的虚拟现实，计算机在计算盒里

summary.en: Meta’s 23 September 2026 announcement, the same day as the Meta VR channel film “Introducing Meta VR Glasses | Spring 2027,” presents a VR device shaped like glasses, on sale in spring 2027 for $1,299.99. Meta says the glasses weigh about 100 grams, five times lighter than Quest 3, because the sensors and a micro-OLED “5K Infinite Display” (37 pixels per degree, Dolby Vision, pancake lenses) stay on the face, while compute, battery, and storage sit in a puck on an optical tether. The frame is magnesium alloy. The sides are open and a passthrough camera is there so the room is not fully gone. Dolby Atmos is in the frames. Meta AI is built into the OS: voice, eyes, and hand gestures, with no controller required. Touch Plus controllers are optional and sold separately for the existing Quest catalog. The announcement names Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Reality Elite. The developer overview instead lists Snapdragon XR2 Gen 3. This page reports both and does not decide they are the same chip. The puck battery is rated up to three hours of high-resolution media playback, with 45W charging. The next day’s developer post says the v207 SDKs are already available, that the glasses run the same OS and Store as Quest, and that the field of view is roughly 70 by 66 degrees against Quest 3’s 110 by 96. The announcement also describes a hologram of the wearer for calls in WhatsApp, Zoom Workplace, and other apps, driven so that other people see a face. This is glasses-form VR: the virtual environment is the primary space, and the form factor does not move it into the AI-glasses product line. Passthrough and a hologram placed in front of you are mixed-reality features in the product sense. They do not make the device “AI glasses rather than VR.”
summary.zh: Meta 2026 年 9 月 23 日的宣布，和 Meta VR 频道影片《Introducing Meta VR Glasses | Spring 2027》是同一天。它介绍的是一款做成眼镜外形的 VR 设备，2027 年春季开售，售价 1299.99 美元。Meta 说眼镜大约 100 克，比 Quest 3 轻五倍，因为传感器和一块微 OLED「5K Infinite Display」（每度 37 像素，Dolby Vision，薄饼透镜）留在脸上，计算、电池和存储放在用光缆相连的计算盒里。镜框是镁合金。两侧敞开，并有透视相机，所以房间不会完全消失。Dolby Atmos 做在镜框里。Meta AI 做进操作系统：语音、眼睛和手势，不强制用手柄。Touch Plus 手柄可选，单独卖，用来玩已有的 Quest 目录。宣布稿写的芯片是高通 Snapdragon Reality Elite。开发者概览写的是 Snapdragon XR2 Gen 3。本页两说并列，不判定它们是不是同一块芯片。计算盒电池被标成高分辨率媒体连续播放最多三小时，支持 45W 充电。次日的开发者文章说 v207 SDK 已经可以拿，眼镜和 Quest 用同一套操作系统和商店，视场大约 70×66 度，对比 Quest 3 的 110×96。宣布稿还描述了佩戴者的全息影像，用于 WhatsApp、Zoom Workplace 和其他应用的通话，让对方看见一张脸。这是眼镜形态的 VR：虚拟环境是主要空间，外形并没有把它划进 AI 眼镜那条产品线。透视，以及把全息影像放在你面前，是产品意义上的混合现实功能。它们不会把这台设备变成「与其说是 VR，不如说是 AI 眼镜」。

cover_alt.zh: 产品渲染图：黑色包裹式 Meta VR Glasses，用线连到一只带夹子的口袋计算盒。

cover_credit.en: Image: Meta product still from meta.com/vr-glasses/ and the 23 Sep 2026 announcement.
cover_credit.zh: 图片：Meta 产品图，来自 meta.com/vr-glasses/ 与 2026 年 9 月 23 日的宣布稿。

nm.en: Meta AI in the OS, and a hologram that sends a generated face to the person on the other end, are the neural-media angles: a model in the loop, and a face synthesized for the call. Eye and hand input are how you drive the virtual space. They are not the implanted interface tracked on the BCI page.
nm.zh: 操作系统里的 Meta AI，以及把一张生成的脸送给通话另一端的全息影像，是和神经媒体相关的一面：回路里有一个模型，通话用的是合成出来的脸。眼睛和手是你驱动虚拟空间的方式。它们不是脑机接口页在追踪的植入式界面。

title.en: Ray-Ban Display adds landmark navigation, a voice-driven hologram, and five more countries
title.zh: Ray-Ban Display 加上地标导航、由声音驱动的全息影像，并进入五个新市场

summary.en: Meta’s 23 September 2026 post on Ray-Ban Display is about the display-AI-glasses line, not about the VR glasses announced the same day. New navigation: cycling directions and live transit departures, starting later that month in the US and Canada, and walking prompts that name what is in front of you (“turn left at the yellow house”) instead of a street sign. Hologram, later in the fall and first as a WhatsApp early access for US owners, builds a photorealistic face from a short capture in the Meta AI app; Meta says the face is driven by the voice, and the model infers expression from what is said and how. An on-glasses Explore app for web apps is described as coming soon. Dolby Atmos capture is claimed as a first on consumer glasses. Calendar can show who is in a meeting, accept or decline, and join, in English in the US at launch. Mirrored phone notifications are “coming soon.” Threads can show community feeds. Sales: the UK and Canada from 23 September, from £749 and CA$1,149; France, Italy, and Germany open pre-order the same day from €899, with availability on 13 October; the US stays from $799 and can now be ordered online. Prescription lenses through meta.com are named for the US and Canada. The in-lens panel these features use is the display HUD. Landmark phrases and a caption are not, on the evidence of this post, graphics registered in three dimensions to the street, so this entry is not tagged AR.
summary.zh: Meta 2026 年 9 月 23 日这篇谈 Ray-Ban Display 的文章，说的是显示类 AI 眼镜，不是同一天宣布的那款 VR 眼镜。导航上的新功能：骑行路线和实时公交班次，当月稍晚在美国和加拿大开始；步行提示改说你眼前的东西（「在黄色房子那里左转」），而不是路牌上的街名。全息影像在秋末、首先作为美国用户的 WhatsApp 早期体验：在 Meta AI 应用里做一次短采集，生成一张看起来像真人的脸；Meta 说这张脸由声音驱动，模型根据说了什么、怎么说来推断表情。眼镜上用来找网页应用的 Explore 被写成即将到来。Dolby Atmos 采集被说成消费级眼镜上的第一次。日历可以在美国、英语环境下看到与会者、接受或拒绝、并加入会议。手机通知镜像是「即将到来」。Threads 可以看社区信息流。销售：英国和加拿大 9 月 23 日起开卖，起价 749 英镑和 1149 加元；法国、意大利和德国同日开放预订，起价 899 欧元，10 月 13 日到货；美国仍从 799 美元起，并可以网购。通过 meta.com 配处方镜片的说法写的是美国和加拿大。这些功能用的是镜片里的 HUD。就这篇文章给出的证据，地标句子和字幕并不是在三维上配准到街道的图形，所以这条不标 AR。

nm.en: The hologram is the neural-media piece: a model infers a face from the voice and plays it to someone else. Navigation that talks about the house in front of you is a generated description of the scene, still shown as a HUD, not as a model locked to the curb.
nm.zh: 全息影像是和神经媒体相关的那一块：模型从声音推断出一张脸，再放给别人看。导航改口说你眼前的房子，是对场景的一段生成描述，仍然显示在 HUD 里，不是锁在路沿上的模型。

title.en: visionOS 27: Siri in the room, and panoramas with depth
title.zh: visionOS 27：Siri 放在房间里，全景有了深度

summary.en: Apple’s newsroom post, updated 14 September 2026, says visionOS 27 is out that day along with the other OS 27 releases. Apple’s security note uses the same release date. 10:02 am Pacific, as reported by MacRumors, is after midnight in China, so the sort date here is the 15th. On Vision Pro with M2 or later, Siri AI can use personal context, act in apps, and read what is on screen. It can be pinned in space. You can look at it and speak without “Hey Siri.” Visual Intelligence asks about a physical object in the room or about something on a screen, by looking. Spatial features in the support notes include panoramas turned into scenes with depth, a panorama saved as your own environment, curved windows, 3D models pulled from a Mac into the room at real scale, a Thórsmörk environment, and 360-degree web backgrounds in Safari. High-quality recording can capture the unfoveated view in 4K for up to three minutes. Look to Drive sends an eye command to a compatible powered wheelchair. These are spatial features on a video-see-through headset. A 360 background is a format played in the headset, which is why it is not tagged as if “360” meant VR by itself. Asking about an object you look at is the nearest thing to registered AR in the notes; Apple describes it as a question about the physical object, not as a mesh locked to that object, so the entry is tagged MR in the product sense rather than AR.
summary.zh: Apple 新闻室的文章在 2026 年 9 月 14 日更新，写明 visionOS 27 于当天和其他 OS 27 一起推出。Apple 的安全说明用的是同一个发布日。MacRumors 写的太平洋时间上午 10:02 已经过了中国的午夜，所以这里的排序日期是 15 日。在 M2 及更新的 Vision Pro 上，Siri AI 可以使用个人上下文、在应用里行动，并读取屏幕上的内容。它可以钉在空间里。看着它说话，不必说 “Hey Siri”。视觉智能靠注视来询问房间里的实物，或屏幕上的内容。支持说明里的空间功能包括：全景变成有深度的场景、把一张全景存成自己的环境、弯曲的窗口、从 Mac 把三维模型以真实比例拉进房间、Thórsmörk 环境，以及 Safari 里 360 度的网页背景。高质量录制可以以 4K 录下非中央凹的整幅画面，最长三分钟。Look to Drive 用眼睛把移动指令发给兼容的电动轮椅。这些是视频透视头显上的空间功能。360 度背景是在头显里播放的一种格式，所以不会因为出现了 “360” 就把这条标成 VR 本身。对着物体发问，是说明里最接近配准 AR 的一点；Apple 把它写成对实物的提问，不是锁在该物体上的网格，所以这条按产品意义标 MR，不标 AR。

cover_alt.en: Apple marketing image: a translucent panel in a living room answers a question about hiking boots and a backpack on the table, with a small glowing orb nearby.
cover_alt.zh: Apple 宣传图：客厅里一块半透明面板正在回答桌上登山靴和背包的问题，旁边有一颗小的发光球体。

cover_credit.en: Image: Apple Newsroom, visionOS 27 Visual Intelligence artwork (September 2026).
cover_credit.zh: 图片：Apple 新闻室，visionOS 27 视觉智能配图（2026 年 9 月）。

nm.en: Visual Intelligence and a Siri that stays pinned in the room are the neural-media angles: a model that answers about what you look at, and an agent given a place in the same space as the furniture. The 4K capture of the unfoveated view is first-person media of that space. None of this is the BCI page’s implant story.
nm.zh: 视觉智能，以及钉在房间里的 Siri，是和神经媒体相关的一面：一个模型回答你正在看的东西，一个代理在家具所在的同一空间里有了位置。4K 录下的非中央凹画面，是这个空间的第一人称媒介。这些都不是脑机接口页里的植入故事。

date_display.zh: 2026 年 8 月 17 日那一周

title.en: Horizon OS 2.7: display size, a gamepad mode, and up to three virtual screens
title.zh: Horizon OS 2.7：显示大小、手柄的游戏手柄模式，以及最多三块虚拟屏幕

summary.en: Meta’s Quest notes say version 2.7 starts reaching Quest 3, Quest 3S, Quest Pro, and Quest 2 in the week of 17 August 2026. Display size can be Small, Medium, Large, or Extra Large, from Settings, and applies across apps. On Quest 3 and Quest 3S, Touch controllers can emulate an Xbox gamepad for Xbox and Steam Link; Meta and Menu together enter that mode. Remote Desktop is renamed Virtual Display, is installed on every headset, and shows up to three large screens from a Windows or Mac computer. An optional HDMI-to-USB-C adapter brings in a console, a handheld, or a phone; Meta says the separate HDMI Link app will be wound down. Three virtual screens are a VR workspace: the virtual environment is the primary space, even when the thing on the screen is a flat desktop. The notes do not describe those screens as registered to the physical desk.
summary.zh: Meta 的 Quest 说明写：2.7 从 2026 年 8 月 17 日那一周开始推向 Quest 3、Quest 3S、Quest Pro 和 Quest 2。显示大小可以在设置里选小、中、大或特大，并对各应用生效。在 Quest 3 和 Quest 3S 上，Touch 手柄可以模拟 Xbox 游戏手柄，给 Xbox 和 Steam Link 用；同时按下 Meta 键和菜单键进入该模式。远程桌面改名为虚拟显示，预装在每台头显上，可以把 Windows 或 Mac 的画面放到最多三块大屏幕上。可选的 HDMI 转 USB-C 转接器可以接游戏机、掌机或手机；Meta 说独立的 HDMI Link 应用将停止。三块虚拟屏幕是一个 VR 工作区：虚拟环境是主要空间，哪怕屏幕上放的是一块平面桌面。说明没有把这些屏幕写成配准到了真实桌子上。

title.en: Ray-Ban Display, six months in: handwriting, captions, and a web-app preview
title.zh: Ray-Ban Display 上市半年：手写、字幕，以及网页应用预览

summary.en: Meta’s 14 May 2026 post says several features start rolling out that day on Ray-Ban Display. Neural handwriting is open to everyone in the post’s account, for Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and the phone’s own messaging apps, in English in the US. Display recording combines the in-lens UI, the camera’s view of the world, and audio into one clip; the later release notes limit that recording to English in the US. Walking directions expand to the whole US and to cities including London, Paris, and Rome. Live captions, already described for in-person speech and phone calls, are coming to WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram Direct voice. The same post opens a developer preview: web apps in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, deployed by URL, and the Wearables Device Access Toolkit, which can put text, images, lists, buttons, and video on the display of an existing phone app. The post says Muse Spark “will arrive” on the glasses that summer; this page does not treat that sentence as a shipment. Ray-Ban’s product page and Meta’s web-apps guide both describe the panel as 600×600. It sits in one lens, off the center of view. That is a display HUD on camera-and-display AI glasses. Captions and a fixed navigation card are not tagged AR here, because the sources do not show the pixels registered to the street or the speaker.
summary.zh: Meta 2026 年 5 月 14 日的文章说，当天起有一批功能在 Ray-Ban Display 上推出。按文章的说法，神经手写对所有人开放，可用于 Instagram、WhatsApp、Messenger 以及手机自带的短信，语言为美国英语。显示录制把镜片里的界面、相机看到的世界和声音合成一条视频；后来的发布说明把这项录制限制在美国英语。步行导航扩到整个美国，以及伦敦、巴黎、罗马等城市。实时字幕原本用于当面说话和电话，将扩展到 WhatsApp、Messenger 和 Instagram Direct 的语音。同一篇文章开放了开发者预览：用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 写网页应用，通过网址部署；可穿戴设备访问工具包则可以在已有的手机应用上，把文字、图片、列表、按钮和视频放到眼镜显示里。文章说 Muse Spark「将于」当年夏天到达眼镜；本页不把这句话当成已经出货。Ray-Ban 的产品页和 Meta 的网页应用文档都把这块面板写成 600×600。它在一只镜片里，偏离视线中心。这是相机加显示的 AI 眼镜上的一块 HUD。字幕和一块固定的导航卡片在这里不标 AR，因为来源没有显示这些像素配准到了街道或说话的人。

source.en: Meta, Six Months of Meta Ray-Ban Display
source.zh: Meta《Meta Ray-Ban Display 的六个月》

cover_alt.en: Product render of black Ray-Ban Meta glasses floating above a woven wristband with a row of sensor pads.
cover_alt.zh: 产品渲染图：黑色 Ray-Ban Meta 眼镜悬在一条编织腕带上方，腕带上有一排传感贴片。

cover_credit.en: Image: Meta, “Six Months of Meta Ray-Ban Display” (14 May 2026).
cover_credit.zh: 图片：Meta，《Meta Ray-Ban Display 的六个月》（2026 年 5 月 14 日）。

nm.en: Captions on the world in front of you, and a recording that keeps both the HUD and the camera view, are the neural-media angles: a model writes what it heard onto the scene, and the glasses keep a first-person clip of that overlay. Handwriting uses the wristband. Meta’s 2025 post describes that band as reading muscle activity, not neural tissue.
nm.zh: 给眼前的世界加字幕，以及同时留下 HUD 和相机画面的录制，是和神经媒体相关的一面：模型把听到的写到场景上，眼镜留下这段叠加的第一人称片段。手写用的是腕带。Meta 2025 年的文章把这条带子写成读取肌肉活动，不是神经组织。
